description: Structural codebase MCP server with persistent memory: navigate by symbol, recall across sessions.
name: io.github.Mibayy/token-savior

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of absolute paths to project roots to index.
environmentVariables.name: WORKSPACE_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Optional client identifier (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'hermes') for usage attribution.
environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_SAVIOR_CLIENT

environmentVariables.description: Manifest size. 'optimized' (recommended) advertises the Pareto-optimal 15-tool set; 'auto' sizes it from your own usage; 'full' advertises every tool; 'compact-only' if you already run symbol navigation elsewhere.
environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_SAVIOR_PROFILE
